facts.fact: La Presse says Tunisia has deployed a national information systems security strategy 2026-2030, drawn up by a technical committee under the National Security Council's communications and information security commission, after a first cycle covering 2020-2025.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de la sécurité des systèmes informatiques 2026-2030

facts.fact: According to the ANCS, tunCERT published 336 security advisories on vulnerabilities and malware in the first half of 2026, issued in July.
The ANCS says it detected 657,540 incidents in the first half of 2026, including 35,000 DDoS attacks, a count that gives no account of action taken.

systems.system: Agence nationale de la cyber-sécurité (ANCS) / tunCERT

TUN.note: Only a call for continuity and recovery plans; no backup site named.

facts.fact: La Presse says the national information systems security strategy 2026-2030 was drawn up with ministries, public bodies, private-sector representatives and experts, and that a broad national consultation was launched on it.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de la sécurité des systèmes informatiques 2026-2030
